queries.title: Scan control: the same columns, a plain aggregate per user
queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(n) AS events, sum(s) AS searches, sum(c) AS clicks, sum(dl) AS downloads
FROM (SELECT UserID, count(*) AS n, count_if(searched) AS s, count_if(clicked) AS c, count_if(downloaded) AS dl,
             min(ts) AS first_seen, max(d) AS last_day, max(CounterID) AS site
      FROM hits GROUP BY UserID);

queries.title: Sessions per user, 30-minute gap (window function)
queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(sessions) AS sessions FROM (
  SELECT UserID, max(sid) AS sessions FROM (
    SELECT UserID, sessionize(ts, INTERVAL '30 minutes') OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY ts) AS sid FROM hits)
  GROUP BY UserID);
queries.baseline_sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(sessions) AS sessions FROM (
  SELECT UserID, max(sid) AS sessions FROM (
    SELECT UserID,
           1 + sum(CASE WHEN gap > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                 OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS sid
    FROM (SELECT UserID, ts, ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY ts) AS gap FROM hits))
  GROUP BY UserID);

queries.title: Seven-day retention from 2013-07-02
queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(r[1]::INT) AS d0, sum(r[2]::INT) AS d1, sum(r[3]::INT) AS d2, sum(r[4]::INT) AS d3, sum(r[5]::INT) AS d4, sum(r[6]::INT) AS d5, sum(r[7]::INT) AS d6
FROM (SELECT retention(d = DATE '2013-07-02', d = DATE '2013-07-03', d = DATE '2013-07-04', d = DATE '2013-07-05', d = DATE '2013-07-06', d = DATE '2013-07-07', d = DATE '2013-07-08') AS r FROM hits GROUP BY UserID);
queries.baseline_sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(c1::INT) AS d0, sum((c1 AND c2)::INT) AS d1, sum((c1 AND c3)::INT) AS d2, sum((c1 AND c4)::INT) AS d3, sum((c1 AND c5)::INT) AS d4, sum((c1 AND c6)::INT) AS d5, sum((c1 AND c7)::INT) AS d6
FROM (SELECT bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-02') AS c1, bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-03') AS c2, bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-04') AS c3, bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-05') AS c4, bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-06') AS c5, bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-07') AS c6, bool_or(d = DATE '2013-07-08') AS c7 FROM hits GROUP BY UserID);

queries.title: Funnel search, link click, download within 1 hour
The same funnel, returning each step's timestamp
queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(len(e)) AS steps FROM (
  SELECT window_funnel_events(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts, searched, clicked, downloaded) AS e FROM hits GROUP BY UserID);

queries.title: Search then link click within 5 minutes
Count of search ... link click pairs
queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(c) AS matches FROM (
  SELECT sequence_count('(?1).*(?2)', ts, searched, clicked) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserID);

queries.title: Timestamps of the search ... link click pair
queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS users, sum(len(e)) AS steps FROM (
  SELECT sequence_match_events('(?1).*(?2)', ts, searched, clicked) AS e FROM hits GROUP BY UserID);

queries.title: Site visited right after the first search
The funnel over every row as a single group
queries.sql: SELECT window_funnel(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts, searched, clicked, downloaded) AS level FROM hits;

queries.title: search ... link click pairs over every row as a single group
queries.sql: SELECT sequence_count('(?1).*(?2)', ts, searched, clicked) AS matches FROM hits;
